caption: The drawing features a single, symmetrical flower-like object centered on a plain, light beige background. The flower is composed of six large, rounded petals arranged in a radial pattern around a circular center. The petals are rendered with shades of white, gray, light blue, and pale pink, with a pearlescent appearance. Each petal is bordered by small dots of blue and white, and displays inner detailing with additional layers of these colors. The center of the flower contains a ring of twelve small, pearl-like circles surrounding a single, solid black circle. The entire composition is centered and isolated, with no additional objects or background details present.
title: Tie-back
